dedupe_keys.name: infc italian national forest inventory statistics elementary data and webgis maps

description: The inventarioforestale.org site gives access to the results and products of INFC, the Italian national inventory of forests and forest carbon stocks: statistics, elementary data and project documentation, which is needed to interpret the figures. Elementary data are the base data used to produce the INFC statistics, derived from field observations and measurements and processed with procedures developed by the CREA Research Centre for Forestry and Wood, and INFC2015 maps have been published in a WebGIS. The data and documents belong to CUFA and CREA. Elementary data are free and may be used for any purpose, including commercial use, except to produce forest resource statistics at national, regional or other territorial level, because INFC is an official national statistical survey. The data area needs registration. Caveats: the site is in Italian, and the reuse terms restrict statistical estimates. Coverage is Italy. It supports green infrastructure and forest condition analysis, for example wildfire and storm exposure of forests near infrastructure, and climate adaptation; related records are DataIFN of France and the German Bundeswaldinventur.
